status: portable typed-loan consumer implemented; initialized-source runtime acceptance pending
scope: The record adapter validates a completed SourceCharacterOwnerAliases loan against the public typed campaign FSM loan, constructs NativeSkillLuaServices V1/V3 directly from its actual references, installs those AI/state delegates in SessionSkillServices, and binds source-plan playback directly to CombatSession::play_actor_source_sequence.
callback_transport: V1 delegates to the existing scoped helper; V3 uses the same original SkillCallback state machine with indexed source returns and same-VM scope validation. Scope is fetched for each synchronous callback and never retained.
lifetime: The Session and NativeSkillLuaServices must outlive SessionSkillAnimation. The typed FSM loan's record/context pins are retained by the fresh-borrow closure. SessionSkillAnimation's actor_binding_lease remains the host-lifecycle witness, not a source Character field.
does_not_create: VM, slots, or private owner graph
typed_source_loan: model_renderer::SourceCampaignCharacterSkillContextBorrowV1 now exposes the same record/FSM pins, machine, native Session V1/V3, Session PropertyView, pinned SkillTables Borrow, exact-one V1/V3 instance owner, FSM-owned SkillAIContextV3 and SkillStateV4, and original AI/state service callbacks. A record-based overload avoids requiring an Android World lookup when the caller already has the canonical record.
host_mapping: The caller must supply a fresh Host ActorId to native Character identity resolver. The binding validates that mapping against completed-character aliases each borrow and rejects identity changes; it never assumes the integer domains match.
fresh_borrow_api: make_canonical_session_skill_borrower<Loan> accepts a source identity resolver and a typed record-based loan callback. Every SessionSkillAnimation borrow reacquires completed aliases and the current typed FSM loan, then retains the refreshed record/FSM pins through the next synchronous use. make_canonical_session_skill_actor creates the initial host/native actor view from the same authenticated loan.
native_service_api: bind_canonical_native_skill_services consumes the loan's actual Session, instance owner, SkillTables Borrow, NativeFsm24, AI/State context, and source providers; it does not copy any of them. It also installs the same-owner scoped callback transports and same-CombatSession pose/completion handlers.
remaining_runtime_requirements: A genuinely completed InitPost/InitFinal graph and an active selected source Session are required; prefix-only or uninitialized records reject.
The caller must provide actual source animation selection, source row/hotbar/native-index providers and required host leaves not supplied by NativeSkillLuaServices.
Live initialized-record acceptance through the portable Windows CombatSession and Android campaign source graph remains unverified.
integration_boundary: No alternate VM, instance vector, FSM, state, or property owner is created. The binder does not register a new source VM/FSM or claim a complete gameplay cast. SessionSkillServices.play uses CombatSession's existing retained actor pose owner; completion checks that retained timeline's ended state. Source AI/State operation must still come from the canonical typed loan.
